text: 商务部新闻发言人就美制裁中国企业答记者问。 问：美东时间11月5日，美国务院宣布制裁两家中国企业。有消息称，这是美首次以涉古巴为由对中国企业实施制裁。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。美方以涉及第三方为由，对中国企业采取单边制裁，违反国际法和国际关系基本准则，中方对此坚决反对。 近期，美方升级对中方制裁打压，密集出台多项歧视性限制措施，严重损害中国企业权益，背离两国元首达成的重要共识，破坏中美经贸关系稳定。中方敦促美方尽快纠正错误做法，并保留采取必要措施、维护自身正当权益的权利。（商务部网站）
text_en: A spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce answered questions on U.S. sanctions against Chinese companies. Q: On November 5 Eastern Time, the U.S. State Department announced sanctions on two Chinese companies. Reports say this is the first time the U.S. has imposed sanctions on Chinese companies over Cuba-related grounds. What is China's comment? A: We have noted the situation. The U.S. side has imposed unilateral sanctions on Chinese companies on grounds involving a third party, which violates international law and the basic norms of international relations. China firmly opposes this. Recently, the U.S. side has escalated sanctions and suppression against China, intensively introducing multiple discriminatory restrictive measures, seriously harming the rights and interests of Chinese companies, departing from the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, and undermining the stability of China-U.S. economic and trade relations. China urges the U.S. side to correct its erroneous practices as soon as possible, and reserves the right to take necessary measures to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests. (Ministry of Commerce website)
